name: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Revolution! Rinagisa
original_name: その花びらにくちづけを　れぼりゅーしょん！ りなぎさ
source:
A continuation of the story from [url=/v16262]Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: New Gen![/url],

Circumstances have left Rina very upset with Nagisa. She's tried everything to talk it through, but Rina won't listen.

"I'm sure...... if we could just talk properly, she'd understand."

With an odd yuri couple like Nagisa with her worldly maturity and selfish princess Rina, things heat up after a lover's quarrel.

[Edited From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE167943.html]DLsite English[/url]]
